entity_matching: Exact Wikidata P1653 TERC; city-county codes identify the same city municipality, not the surrounding land county.
scope: All canonical records matched to Wikidata using P1653; every P41 statement recorded, current claims checked against Commons metadata and downloaded bytes SHA-1. Polish Wikipedia infobox checked for every absent P41 and the obsolete Parczew P41. No missing statement or exclusion implies a county lacks a flag.
